description: Arx custom login address for one hosted WordPress site (serviceId). get (default): whether it is on, the slug and full login addresses, emergency state, author pages setting and whether the live site matches (status applied = the new address works and /wp-login.php answers 404). Changes need confirm: enable (optional slug, else the current or a new random one), disable (back to /wp-login.php), set_slug (slug: 4-64 letters, digits, - or _), reset_slug (new random address, old one stops working), author_archives (authorArchives404 true = author pages answer 404 to visitors), emergency_off (opens the normal login again within about two minutes, nothing else changes; use when someone is locked out; customers and Lanetti support) and emergency_clear (Lanetti support only: hides the normal login again; a customer's enable does not end an emergency). The OMA one-click login, admin-ajax, REST and WooCommerce My account keep working.

action.description: get is default; every other action needs confirm. emergency_off: customers and Lanetti support. emergency_clear: Lanetti support only.

authorArchives404.description: author_archives: true = author pages answer 404 to visitors.

slug.description: enable / set_slug: the login address, 4-64 letters, digits, - or _ (e.g. kirjaudu-x7).
